newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan Taleban seize 13 tonnes of hashish.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban seize 13 tonnes of hashish.

text.p: Officials from Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic administration have seized more than 13 tonnes of hashish intended to be smuggled abroad, Kabul radio said on Thursday night.
The broadcast, monitored in Islamabad, called the consignment unprecedented and said it was due to be shipped abroad by smugglers through western provinces bordering Iran.

The Voice of Shariah radio quoted the head of the Interior Ministry's anti-smuggling department, Maulvi Gul Hasan, as saying the hashish had been packed and processed using modern equipment and disguised as packets of biscuits.
Anti-smuggling and anti-drug officials of the Criminal Investigation Department made the seizure in Kabul "recently", with the cooperation of the Taleban militia, he said.
Those involved in the smuggling had also been seized.
